external_human_studies.title_original: 紫微斗數與具信效度心理量表的相關
external_human_studies.title_english: Are traditional Chinese fortune-telling approach, Zi Wei Dou Shu, associated with well-established psychological inventories
external_human_studies.institution_or_journal: Chung Shan Medical University, Department of Psychology / Clinical Psychology master's thesis
external_human_studies.study_kind: existing external completed human observational comparison
psychometric_comparators: Big Five Mini-Markers / traditional Chinese adaptation
external_human_studies.astrological_method: Experienced practitioners inspected Zi Wei charts derived from participants' birth year, month and day as described in the abstract.
author_reported_findings: No overall significant correlations between astrological judgments and the psychological inventory measurements.
No significant relationships when examined by sex or Eastern/Western religious grouping.
Low positive correlation for friendliness among participants with religion.
Marginally significant positive friendliness correlation in subgroup not believing Zi Wei.
limitations: The abstract reports correlations, not pre-registered prospective predictive performance.
The full thesis is not accessible through the checked institutional archive without requesting a copy.
The significant subgroup correlations may be chance among numerous subgroup/outcome comparisons; this cannot be adjudicated from abstract alone.
Generalization beyond Taiwanese university respondents unknown.
No validated numerical effect size or confidence interval transcribed.
external_human_studies.implication_for_humandesign: External negative evidence against at least some practiced Zi Wei psychological interpretations. Future models should compare directly to these null results and quantify out-of-sample improvement, with calibrated baselines and corrections.

external_human_studies.title_english: The marginal fate effect of smoking behavior
external_human_studies.institution_or_journal: Tamkang University Master's Program in Economics and Finance, thesis (78 pages)
external_human_studies.study_kind: existing external completed human mixed-method smoking behavior research
reported_analytic_comparisons: individual principal stars including special status
four Zi Wei personality group categories
reported_regression_table_titles: Table 5.1 14 principal stars with special states and estimated smoking tendencies
Tables 5.2–5.3 four group categories with/without status variables
Tables 5.4–5.6 fourteen principal stars total and sex subgroups
Tables 5.7–5.9 all star combinations overall and sex subgroups
Tables 5.10–5.11 smoking and cigarette-warning images difference-in-differences
author_reported_findings: Innovative/leadership categories were described as having greater smoking tendency than supportive/cooperative categories.
Qualitative interviewees described loneliness and enjoying solitude; the author connected this to Zi Wei narratives.
A distinct warning-image difference-in-differences finding was reported as no deterrent effect, alongside some positive qualitative marginal response.
external_human_studies.cites_2018_evidence_basis: University full bibliographic references specifically list 張惠清 (2018).
limitations: University indicates open full text from 2020-07-14 but the actual download button redirects to SSO institutional proxy.
Abstract reports direction, not numeric effect size, standard errors or covariate-controlled comparison.
Smoking is influenced by age, sex, education, cohort, peer access, socioeconomic context and policy exposures; residual confounding unresolved.
It is not a verified independent prospective chart-prediction trial.
The qualitative loneliness result is not a calibrated or independently confirmed natal predictor.
The DID cigarette-package warning analysis is a separate research question and not evidence astrological personality types predict smoking.
external_human_studies.implication_for_humandesign: Explicit candidate positive Zi Wei smoking/group-category claim to audit once full tables become accessible. Pre-register a single constrained chart-category-smoking prediction versus strong nonastrological baseline, not optimistic selection among 14 star and sex subgroup tables.

external_human_studies.title_english: An empirical test of the astrological theory of personality
external_human_studies.reported_method: Each subject and a relative/friend attempted to select the subject's horoscope from five, with astrologer, subject, nominee and psychometric five-dimensional personality judgments.
author_reported_findings: Neither subject nor nominated person correctly identified the appropriate natal horoscope under the study.
Astrologer trait ratings were not correlated with psychometric, subject or nominee ratings.
Psychometric, subject and nominee ratings had some agreement.

external_human_studies.reported_method: Two double-blind comparisons testing natal-chart personality descriptions against people/independently produced personality descriptions.

external_human_studies.title_english: An empirical study of an astrological hypothesis in a twin population
external_human_studies.study_kind: twin parent/relative trait assignment using astrologically drafted polarized descriptions

external_human_studies.title_english: Are personality differences between twins predicted by astrology?
author_reported_findings: Replication attempts did not reproduce the initially high hit rate.
Original trait wording and response artifacts/stereotypes raised methodological issues.
Reanalysis of original data reported no statistically significant deviation from chance.

external_human_studies.title_english: Comments on 'Are personality differences between twins predicted by astrology'
author_reported_findings: Disputed the critique's assertions of post-outcome trait modifications and stereotypes.
Disputed the adequacy of the negative replication.
Reported intention for a future French replication without a validated result shown in this abstract.

cross_study_synthesis.next_evidence_gate: Access actual 2018 and 2020 thesis full methods/tables via authorized request or university library, then extract birth-clock rules, N, covariates, effect sizes, prereg plans, multiple tests and independent validation before any numerical synthesis.
cross_study_synthesis.recommended_next_science: Build new preregistered chart-source-frozen human study with nonastrological baseline, matched natal decoys, power, sealed pre-response predictions, all negatives and blinded outcomes. Replicate the 2018 null scale contrasts and only predeclared 2020 smoking category prediction after full text review.
